'''Geldoll''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Geldoll banned all [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and representatives from the planet in order to fight [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Underworld Trading|No Hutts Allowed}}</ref>
